translation: The Yang Wei arises at the confluence of all the yang [meridians]; its vessel issues at the Jinmen point (BL63) of Foot Taiyang, one cun and five fen below the outer ankle. Ascending seven cun above the outer ankle, it joins Foot Shaoyang at Yangjiao (GB35), which is the xi (cleft) point of the Yang Wei. (Seven cun above the outer ankle, obliquely attached between the two yang [meridians].) Following the outer border of the knee it ascends past the hip joint (bi-yan), reaches the side of the lower abdomen, and joins Foot Shaoyang at Juliao (GB29).
